facts.fact: CCARDESA reports that a national consultation in Moroni on 23 March 2026, with nearly 60 participants, worked to operationalise the World Bank-supported Food Systems Resilience Programme grievance redress mechanism, which takes complaints through in-person submissions, digital platforms and formal channels.
facts.system: Grievance Redress Mechanism (Food Systems Resilience Programme)
